root_cause.text: Multiple parsing logic errors in `mrp_pdu_parse_vecattr()`: failure to decrement `valen` after the third event per byte, omission of early return when `valen` is zero (leaving `FirstValue`/`Vector` fields spuriously consumed), and lack of attribute value increment between byte boundaries, collectively leading to out-of-bounds reads, corrupted PDU parsing, and incorrect applicant state transitions.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description details all three flaws: “valen is exactly a multiple of three, the loop continues after the last valid event … consumes the next byte as a new event byte”; “when valen is zero the parser unconditionally consumes attrlen bytes as FirstValue … corrupts the offset”; “when valen exceeds three … the attribute value is not incremented … this causes the first event of the next byte to use the same attribute value”. The patch adds `if (valen == 0) return 0;` and inside the loop adds `valen--;` and `mrp_attrvalue_inc(…)` after processing each event, directly fixing each of these issues.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add early return when valen is 0 in mrp_pdu_parse_vecattr to skip absent FirstValue and Vector fields per IEEE 802.1ak, preventing incorrect parsing.
intent_record.what: Added an early return when valen is 0, with a comment explaining that only a LeaveAllEvent is present and FirstValue/Vector fields are absent.
intent_record.how: At runtime, when parsing a VectorAttribute with length zero, the function now returns success immediately instead of attempting to parse nonexistent fields, avoiding potential memory access errors and conforming to the IEEE 802.1ak specification.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix parsing of multiple vector attributes in MRP PDU by decrementing remaining length and advancing attribute value pointer after each event.
intent_record.what: Added two lines inside loop: decrement valen and call mrp_attrvalue_inc to advance attribute value pointer after parsing each vector attribute event.
intent_record.how: Ensures that after processing a vector attribute event, the loop decrements the remaining length (valen) and moves the attribute value pointer forward by the attribute length, enabling correct iteration over subsequent attributes in the MRP PDU.
